name: DreamLink
source:
As a new student in Belcrest, you find yourself at the heart of a mystery that will shape the very nature of existence. Visited by odd dreams and visions... could they be something more? Dreams blur with reality - a greater threat emerges, casting a shadow over both realms. At the precipice of history, the choice now falls to you. What path will you take?

[From [url=https://noctusgames.itch.io/dreamlink]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为贝尔克雷斯特的一名新生，你发现自己处于一个谜团的核心，这个谜团将塑造存在的本质。被奇怪的梦境和幻象拜访……还能有更多的东西吗？梦想与现实变得模糊——更大的威胁出现，给两个领域都蒙上了阴影。站在历史的悬崖边，选择权就落在了你们身上。你会走哪条路？

[来自[url=https://noctusgames.itch.io/dreamlink]Itch.io[/url]]
